anti_overlap: fd-user-journey-completeness covers gaps and missing states
fd-technical-feasibility covers whether systems can execute conversations
decision_lens: Prioritizes findings where conversation design principles stated in the PRD are not carried through into the CUJ designs, and where failure modes in async SMS are not adequately anticipated.
focus: Evaluates the quality, completeness, and coherence of conversation design across onboarding, recs, and dating flows
name: fd-conversation-design
persona: A conversation designer and UX writer with experience in voice interfaces, chatbot systems, and behavioral product design. Reads the document as a dialogue director who knows that every bad turn is a churned user.
review_areas: Whether the five conversation design principles are all reflected in the onboarding CUJ's specific step descriptions
Whether the transition from recs conversation to dating upsell feels earned and human vs. a scripted trigger
Whether failure modes in the CUJs are actionable for conversation design
Whether async voice note interaction has been fully thought through: 3-minute voice notes, multiple in a row, ambiguous messages
Whether the profile-building accumulation is surfaced to the user during conversation
Whether the contextual recommendation CUJ adequately distinguishes a Auraken response from a GPT response
success_hints: Every conversation step in the CUJs ends with a prompt that would make a real user want to reply
The onboarding flow can reach a first-quality recommendation in 3-4 exchanges without any exchange feeling like data-collection
The contradiction-handling principle has at least one concrete mechanism described
task_context: Auraken is a voice-first AI agent operating via SMS and voice notes that builds preference profiles through conversation and uses them for personalized recommendations and dating profile optimization. This review covers the VISION.md and PRD.md documents at early product stage.
